summary: Second round frontend-only E2E testing of the SILAIGO admin post z-index/dropdown fix and new Dashboard tabs / PDF export / PickupsPage key-warning fix. Customer View per-order tabs render AdminOrderDetailView with the same dropdowns AND nested dialogs (Update Customisations opens a second [role=dialog] whose center point is contained by the top dialog, i.e. not clipped). Dashboard has 3 tabs (Overview + new Team Workload + Customer Demographics), Overview shows the new 'Order Pipeline - where things are stuck' snapshot card. Pickups tab produced zero React 'unique key' warnings. Export PDF button ([data-testid=export-customer-pdf-btn]) is present in the customer modal header and triggered a real download 'Charu_orders.pdf'. No page crashes or console errors across Orders/Customers/Dashboard/Pickups.

Dashboard now has 3 tabs; Team Workload legitimately shows empty state until backend adds order timeline/audit-trail (see /app/memory/BACKEND_CHANGES_NEEDED.md 1b) - do NOT report as bug. rca of the issue: Prev iteration report flagged that in the AdminOrderDetailView, Select popovers and nested dialogs were rendering BEHIND the parent modal because parent DialogOverlay/DialogContent used z-[60]/z-[61] while Radix Select/Dialog descendants default to z-50, so descendants stacked below the parent. Fix (verified this run): remove the z-[60]/z-[61] override on the modal so parent + descendants all use z-50; Radix relies on DOM mount order to correctly layer later-mounted popovers on top, which now works (dropdown zIndex=50, elementFromPoint returns the option; nested dialog centerPoint is contained by the topmost [role=dialog]).
